_about: Evidence per requirement ID for layer 8 (ICS forms and EOC functions: resource requests to the state, ICS forms as documents, the wall briefing display, live conditions, the state read API; docs/plans/layer-8.md), plus earlier rows layer 8 finishes (DSP-10, DSP-11, CON-03, CON-06, FL:FR-05, SCL-09): for those the earlier evidence is kept and layer 8's appended after 'layer 8:'. status: pass | partial | deferred | designed. The cited suites run in CI on every push; the layer merges only when CI is green. tools/reqindex/traceability.py merges trace-layer1..8.json in order.
CON-13: Resource requests to the state in the ICS 213 RR blocks: cg.resource_request, _line, _step (0107) with per-event numbering, priority, delivery location, requester and position, substitutes, suggested sources, cost and finance's reply, the state's tracking number, supplier and ETA; actions resource_request.read/write/submit/approve/place/cancel (approve explicit, self-review guarded) held by the EM director, planning, mass care, AFN and field operations (packages/authz); API: draft (optionally raised from a site's supply request, FL:FR-21), change, submit, approve by a second person, finance reply, place with the state or locally (refused until finance replies when the county sets resource_requests.finance_threshold), en route, received, cancel; every step a row and an audit entry (services/api/src/routes/resource-requests.ts); two exercise requests seeded (tools/seed/src/load.ts); console screen: draft with lines, filters by event and status, submit/approve/place (state or local, with the state's number)/en route/received/cancel, finance's reply, the request's blocks, lines and history with who and when (apps/web-console/src/screens/resource-requests.tsx; nav 'Resource requests' for resource_request.read); ICS forms as documents: ICS 202 objectives per operational period (cg.incident_objective, routes/incident-objectives.ts), ICS 213 general messages drafted, approved by a second person, sent and replied to (cg.general_message, routes/general-messages.ts), and the 201, 213, 213 RR, 214 and 309 built from the event's records into one content model with the edition named on each (packages/reporting/src/ics), previewed for a scope and issued frozen with a SHA-256 and a per-event number (cg.ics_form_issue, routes/ics-forms.ts); tagged PDF (PDF/UA-1) and CSV drawn from the frozen content, every download audited with its scope (SEC-18); seeded objectives and a general message; ICS forms console screen: the period's objectives (add, met, dropped), general messages (draft, approve, send, reply, cancel), pick a form and its scope, preview the blocks, issue, download issued forms as PDF or CSV (apps/web-console/src/screens/ics-forms.tsx; nav 'ICS forms'); the state's read API (SCL-09, plan §7): with an API key of scope eoc.read, approved by a second administrator, a state system reads an event's resource requests with lines and history, significant events for a period, issued situation reports and issued ICS forms (JSON, or the form's PDF) under /api/eoc, every use audited; with scope resource_request.update it sets the state's tracking number and moves a request to placed, en route or received, each a step by the key and a webhook event (services/api/src/routes/eoc-api.ts, migration 0110); webhooks resource_request.submitted and .updated, significant_event.created and ics_form.issued are signed deliveries that carry numbers, statuses and summaries, never a resident (services/worker/src/jobs/eoc-events.ts)

CON-14: Live conditions with their source and age: cg.live_source (a county's feeds: WZDx from a state DOT, the Waze for Cities partner feed, a utility's outage feed, or a file; on or off; refresh period; how the last pull went) and cg.live_condition (one item per feed entry, or a staff entry that overrides feeds for its area; point, line or area on the road network or a utility area, never a home; cleared, never deleted) (0109); parsers for WZDx v4, the Waze partner feed (alerts and jams, no reporter kept) and utility outage GeoJSON (packages/refdata/src/live); the worker pulls every enabled feed on its period through the allow-listed HTTP client, replaying recorded synthetic feeds in development and CI, and a feed that is down leaves its failure on the source beside the last good items (services/worker/src/jobs/live.ts; REFDATA_ALLOWED_HOSTS names the hosts a deployment may reach); API: list with source, age, staleness and whether in force, staff entry (override) and clear, sources added, changed, switched off (items leave the board at once), pulled on demand or fed by file import (services/api/src/routes/live-conditions.ts);
